rules.unit: pass (a complete pass = all its parts used); per-configuration values over kept bursts of used blocks
rules.drops: governor-free cards (all but aifoundry3): busy samples off 600 MHz, or a launch with an implied clock outside 0.595-0.605 GHz (the first launch is not tested when the bracket before the burst is not all at 600 MHz: the wake-up from another idle state); idle brackets never tested (V3-CAT's R-clock idle-bracket rule on aifoundry2 is not applied: CF-GAP gives the registered test without those bursts as a sensitivity); every card: bursts bursts_of cannot cut, heater inside the brackets (guard)
rules.repeats: >= 3 complete passes on a card, else INSUFFICIENT on that card
rules.registered: aifoundry2 and aifoundry3 (the committed 23 Sep catalogue's cards)
rules.all_cards: every expected card (--cards, default the four campaign cards) and any other card present: PASS if the item holds on every card, CARD-DIFFERENT on some, FAIL on none, INSUFFICIENT if a card lacks repeats (outcome_over_cards_with_repeats gives the outcome over the others); an item registered for named cards only is REPORTED on the others
rules.idle_600: a card's idle is at 600 MHz when >= 90% of its kept bursts have every idle sample at 600 MHz; pooled_600idle uses only those cards
rules.interval: 99% two-sided Welch t on pass-level values
